*   **Column Index:** `col = ((uint(i) & 0x3ffu) << 2) | k`, where $k \in \{0, 1, 2, 3\}$ is the texel offset within the splat's block.
**Compute World Covariance:** Construct the scale matrix $S = \text{diag}(s_x, s_y, s_z)$ and rotation matrix $R$ from $q$.
